name: maraudon_orange
notes: DRAFT, census-corrected 2026-10-24 from the world database export of map 349 (tools/dungeongen, spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json): one pull per assist chain of the export's spawns (the critters 2914/13321/6145/4076 are out of every pack), the linked packs of creature_groups kept whole, radii cut to the farthest member (+5 only for a wanderer), the pulls ordered nearest-neighbour inside each leg with the boss last and a 100 yd penalty on a floor change (a walk between two tiers of this map is 250-500 yd: the export's own hop chains measured). Not mapped, not live-checked: do the GM-invisible mapping walk and correct the route before the first run (AUTO-IMPROVE step 0); dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.
No door, lever or key in this wing: map 349 has no door gameobject in the export (only Vylestem Vines, Larva/Corruption Spewers, herbs and deposits). The orange entrance trigger is 3133 (level 30).

Lord Vyletongue (12236) and Celebras the Cursed (12225) are the purple plan's legs (the spec splits the wings by bbox), so this plan does not pull their rooms; a full orange-side clear in game passes them.
The inner bosses Landslide, Tinkerer Gizlock, Rotgrip and Princess Theradras are shared with maraudon_purple.

Meshlok the Harvester (12237, rare rank 2) is a 70% pool spawn on guid 54652 (pool 34901, export shows a Cavern Lurker 12223 at 731.1 -77.0 -57.5): the nearest pull is over 90 yd away, so it is not in any group and not named in a skip; if the party detours to Celebras, that spawn may be the rare.

Rotgrip (13596) and Princess Theradras (12201) walk creature_movement paths (382 yd ~153 s and 104 yd ~42 s from their spawn rows) and their boss rows use the spawn point: the run leader may find them away and waits/searches.

Adds with no spawn row: Noxxion summons Noxxion's Spawn (13456, five at a time) and turns untargetable for 15 s every 40 s; Princess Theradras summons 12238 at 28.07 61.88 -123.41 on aggro. No plan field can list them.
The eight-Vile-Larva and six-Deep-Borer pulls are one linked pack in creature_groups (aggro together) and cannot be split; they are the plan's largest pulls.

Every pull whose walk passes a patroller within 25 yd carries that patroller's creature_movement path as a patrol block with an estimated round (the mapping walk measures it): 85 pulls, the long Theradrim Guardian loops cross most of the inner ring.
The Rotgrip boss point keeps needs_walk: the mapping walk has not been done and no coordinate was invented.
